page.layout: One printed page, text in a single column; the right margin holds faint show-through and partial marginal notes (mostly illegible, from the facing page). Running head at top with page number at left.

main_text.p: ut nobis omnibus satis bene constat.
Spartæ fuit consuetudo, ut fungentes officio magistratus, per id tempus a vino abstinerent. Existimo etiam in de uenire illud, quòd Turcici Imperatores non bibunt uinum.
main_text.head: DE INTEMPERANTIA & ebrietate.
main_text.p: Plato in epistola quadam ad Dionis propinquos, de sua in Siciliam peregrinatione sic scribit: Vita illa beata, quæ fereba tur plena Italicarum Syracusanarumque mensarum, nullo modo mihi placuit, bis in die saturum fieri, neq; unquam pernoctare solum: cæteraq;, quæ comitantur hanc vitam, in qua sapiens nemo efficitur unquam, moderatus verò multo minus.

Pittacus Mitylenæus tulit legem, ut si quis per temulentiam aliquid sceleris commisisset, duplo graviore pœna plecteretur: quòd causa ipsa, quæ eum ad peccatum impulisset, gravius etiam peccatum esset.
In conuentu Ratisbonensi, cum vinum valde bonum cresceret, & multi Germani ex longioribus compotationibus eo anno more

page.notes: The right margin contains show-through from the facing page and fragmentary notes that are not legible; they were not transcribed. Some words in the main text are set in a sloping hand with ligatures, read with [?] where doubtful. The line "moderatus" and "Dionis" were read from the print with reasonable confidence.
